Mad.note: An in-play Townsfolk the Storyteller picks to show the Pixie.
Mad.ambiguous: The wiki doesn't say whether the shown Townsfolk could be the Pixie itself.

Has Ability.note: Replaces Mad on that Townsfolk once they die, when the Pixie gains their ability.
Has Ability.ambiguous: The wiki says to swap Mad for Has Ability but doesn't name whose token it sits by; the swap implies the dead Townsfolk.
